articles.author: Anthony Faiola
articles.title: Medical tests show Pope Leo requires no further treatment for lung cancer - The Washington Post
articles.description: Pope Leo’s doctors have also said there is “no clinical reason” to stop him from continuing with his trip to Latin America next month.
